title: BatchNorm Scale Factors and Network Slimming
analysis: The gamma ranking retained 12 channels above an absolute threshold of 0.635652. After slicing convolution and every BatchNorm state tensor, the narrow output matched the gamma-masked control within 2.438e-04. Parameters fell from 4,368 to 2,184; ranking quality on a real task remains unmeasured.
conclusion: Network Slimming turns BatchNorm scales into a ranking mechanism; deployment benefit begins only after consistent structural removal.
